name: Network and Information Systems Directive (NIS2)
description: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (NIS 2), OJ L 333/80, 27.12.2022. Placeholder pack: nothing in it is evaluated. See README.md. NIS2 is a Directive and has no direct effect on entities: the binding obligations are those of each Member State's transposing law, so a finding labelled 'NIS2' is a claim about 27 national regimes. Citations are anchored by cra/catalogue/anchor-test.sh.

controlSets.name: NIS2: Cybersecurity Risk Management
controlSets.description: Article 21 'Cybersecurity risk-management measures', which Member States must impose on essential and important entities. CITES: Article 21

controls.name: NIS2-1.0 Cybersecurity Risk Management Measures
controls.description: Article 21(2)(d) requires measures covering 'supply chain security, including security-related aspects concerning the relationships between each entity and its direct suppliers or service providers', informed by the coordinated risk assessments of Article 22(1). This control is a placeholder: it asserts nothing about those measures and is never evaluated. CITES: Article 21(2)(d); Article 22(1)
